title: Owner profile, notifications, device pages, owner name, theme switch
owns: the owner name and avatar helper
the theme switch, sign-out sheet and version footer in SettingsRoot.tsx

steps.name: owner-and-notify
steps.lead_notes:
One helper gives the owner's display name and initial everywhere (rail, settings, profile, desktop welcome, the empty-chat greeting): the form of address, else the name, else the e-mail local part. messages-5 touches Conversation.tsx and conversation.css, which belong to package `messages`: keep that hunk to the empty-chat block.
settings_a-13 changes server defaults for proactive contact (calls off, a daily limit): change the default for agents that have no saved setting, never rewrite what an owner saved, and cover it with pytest.
settings_root-12: the footer shows a version that changes with each deploy; the server already exposes a build id (see the version route and UpdateBar). Show it in the reference's form.
settings_a-7: the five Arabic time-zone names from the reference, plus the owner's current zone if it is not one of them, so nobody loses a saved value.

gaps.title: Desktop welcome greets the e-mail local part and ignores the owner's chosen name or form of address
gaps.reference_evidence:
Lonora-Desktop-37.html:3400 welcomeMarkup(): `

مرحبًا ${E(S.owner.address||S.owner.name)}

`. Reference shot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-lonorabot/5d377f24-3ac2-5c89-bb02-ed3686a435ad/scratchpad/audit/shots/desktop/ref-home-dark.png shows «مرحبًا أحمد». DESIGN_TREE_37.md:379: «المحتوى في قسم المحادثات شاشة ترحيب: «مرحبًا …»».
gaps.app_evidence: apps/web/src/shell/Shell.tsx:746 `name={owner.email.split("@")[0]}`. The profile's `address` and `name` (apps/web/src/shell/settings/owner.ts OwnerProfile) are never read here, so the greeting stays «مرحبًا ahmed» even after the owner sets «الاسم» or «طريقة المخاطبة» in the profile. Shot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-lonorabot/5d377f24-3ac2-5c89-bb02-ed3686a435ad/scratchpad/audit/shots/desktop/app-home-dark.png
gaps.owner_sees: Every time the desktop opens on «المحادثات», the welcome reads «مرحبًا ahmed», a lowercase Latin login name, instead of «مرحبًا أحمد» or the form of address they chose in their profile.
gaps.fix_plan: Read the profile once in the shell. Either call useOwnerProfile() in Shell.tsx or, better, expose it from the shell data provider (apps/web/src/shell/data.tsx) so the rail, the settings and the welcome share one fetch. Add `ownerAddress(profile, email) = profile?.address || ownerName(profile, email)` to apps/web/src/shell/settings/owner.ts and pass it to <Welcome name=…> at Shell.tsx:746.
gaps.verifier_note: useOwnerProfile() is a per-call fetch hook (refetches on revision); calling it in Shell is fine and simplest, but the shared provider idea is optional. Add ownerAddress(profile,email)=profile?.address||ownerName(profile,email) to owner.ts. Also check the empty-chat greeting inside chat views (ref line 3808 uses the same address) for the same email-local-part bug. Overlaps gap 1 (same Shell profile read, share one useOwnerProfile call). Mind tests that expect the e-mail local part in the welcome.

gaps.title: Owner avatar initial differs between the rail, the settings and the profile
gaps.reference_evidence: Lonora-Desktop-37.html:3394, rail: `${E(S.owner.name.slice(0,1))}`. The settings and owner pages take the same S.owner.name, so one letter («A» for Ahmed) appears everywhere (ref-home-dark.png and ref-settings.png both show «A»).
gaps.app_evidence: Shell.tsx:854 `ownerInitial={owner.email.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase()}` is the e-mail's first letter, uppercased. SettingsRoot.tsx:305 `name.slice(0, 1)` and OwnerPage.tsx:183 `(form.name || name).slice(0, 1)` take the profile name, or the e-mail local part, without uppercasing. Live check: the rail shows «A» and settings/owner show «a» (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-lonorabot/5d377f24-3ac2-5c89-bb02-ed3686a435ad/scratchpad/audit/shots/desktop/app-settings.png, app-owner.png). Once the profile name is «أحمد», the rail stays «A» while settings shows «أ».
gaps.owner_sees: Their own avatar is «A» in the rail but «a» (or «أ») on the settings card and the profile page, so it looks like two different people.
gaps.fix_plan: Add one helper `ownerInitial(profile, email)` in apps/web/src/shell/settings/owner.ts that takes the first grapheme of ownerName() and uppercases it (toLocaleUpperCase, which leaves Arabic as it is). Use it at Shell.tsx:854 (fed by the shared profile from the welcome fix), SettingsRoot.tsx:305 and OwnerPage.tsx:183. OwnerPage keeps showing the live form value while the owner is editing.
gaps.verifier_note: One helper ownerInitial(profile,email) in owner.ts: first grapheme of ownerName(), toLocaleUpperCase(). Share the profile read with gap 0. Use Array.from(...)[0] for graphemes. Keep OwnerPage's live form value. Also reference account page (line 3693) uses the same letter; check AccountPage if present.

gaps.title: The profile name field is empty while settings and the avatar show the email name
gaps.reference_evidence: Desktop-37 3691: F("الاسم","name",S.owner.name,...) prefilled; the hero shows the name's initial. DESIGN_TREE_37 85: «الملف الشخصي: الاسم + ...».
gaps.app_evidence: OwnerPage.tsx:75-80 `name: profile?.name ?? ""`. With profile.name null (GET /api/owner/profile → "name":null), the field is empty. The hero (line 186) uses ownerName(), which falls back to the email, so it shows a lowercase «a», and the settings root row shows «ahmed». The seed has no profile name, so this is partly data, but the code shows two different names whenever the name is unset.
gaps.owner_sees: Settings greets them as «ahmed», but the profile form says their name is blank.
gaps.fix_plan: In OwnerPage.tsx, prefill name with `profile?.name ?? ownerName(profile, data.owner.email)` (the same value SettingsRoot shows), so saving confirms it. Capitalise the hero initial with toLocaleUpperCase. Separately, seed the demo owner's name «Ahmed» and address «أحمد» in the audit fixture.
gaps.verifier_note: Prefilling the form with the email-derived name would make a Save write that derived name into the profile. Choose deliberately: either do that (the reference does prefill), or keep the field empty and show the email name as a placeholder. The placeholder is the safer option. Hero initial: add toLocaleUpperCase, which is a small change. Do not edit seed data as part of this fix. Overlaps with gap 7 in OwnerPage.tsx, so do both in one pass.

gaps.app_evidence: OwnerPage.tsx:228 `disabled={!profile || busy || !draft}`. NotifyPages.tsx CommunicationPage submit `disabled={busy || !draft}`. Measured live: disabled=true, opacity .55, and the button renders grey (shots/settings1/app-owner-desk.png, app-communication-phone.png).

gaps.fix_plan: Follow the reference: keep the button enabled (disable only while busy). When nothing changed, submitting just closes or does nothing; the server already ignores no-op saves (save_owner_preferences returns changed:false). Apply the same in CommunicationPage.

Make sure submit with no draft is a safe no-op that does not send an empty or default payload that overwrites fields: guard `if (!draft) return` or close, rather than posting the defaults. gaps.title: In «سجل التغييرات», quiet-hours on and off entries look like the same entry twice
gaps.reference_evidence: Desktop-37 8353 diff(): from in <del>, to in <ins>, and when `to` is empty only the struck old value shows. Each entry's label is the field's own name. DESIGN_TREE_37 128: «من كتب · متى · القيمة القديمة والجديدة · استعادة». The settings page calls the section «ساعات الهدوء».
gaps.app_evidence: Reproduced live: turning quiet hours on, then off, gives two rows, «أنت · أوقات الهدوء» with `<del>22:00-08:00</del> <ins>غير محدد</ins>` and «أنت · أوقات الهدوء» with `<ins>22:00-08:00</ins>`. Both rows have the same label and the same red/green time pill (shots/settings1/app-owner-log-phone.png). The server does not duplicate entries (an identical PUT returns changed:false), so this is the report's "duplicate". Value text comes from packages/core/src/owner-profile.ts:183-191, which maps null to «غير محدد». The field label is «أوقات الهدوء», while NotifyPages calls the section «ساعات الهدوء».
gaps.owner_sees: Two identical-looking log lines for one setting, an «غير محدد» that really means «off», and a different name from the settings page.
gaps.fix_plan: In packages/core/src/owner-profile.ts preferenceValueText, return «متوقف» / "Off" for quiet_hours when the value is null, and show the window as «22:00 – 08:00» (en dash, LTR). Rename the quiet_hours field label to «ساعات الهدوء». In OwnerPage.tsx, when `before` is null, show only the <ins>; when `after` is null, show only the <del> plus «متوقف», following the reference's diff(). Also skip rows whose field changes list is empty: device-only changes record a revision with no displayable fields.
gaps.verifier_note: Smallest fix: in owner-profile.ts make quiet_hours null render «متوقف»/Off (and en dash window), and rename the quiet_hours label at line 103 to «ساعات الهدوء» (line 67 quietHours is a separate label, check which the log uses). In OwnerPage.tsx ~307-309 omit <del> when before is null and show it with «متوقف» when after is null. Skipping empty-change rows is an extra; verify before adding. Downgraded to low: wording only, a log row exists per change anyway. Check core tests that assert «غير محدد».

gaps.title: The «الجهاز» section disappears when no passkey device exists, and «مكالمة» can be chosen with nothing to ring
gaps.reference_evidence: Desktop-37 8374-8377 deviceSection() always shows three radio rows: this device (name, «مسجَّل لمفتاح المرور» when registered) · «الحاسوب» · «جميع الأجهزة». DESIGN_TREE_37 117: «الجهاز الذي يصله التنبيه | هذا الجهاز | الحاسوب · جميع الأجهزة».
gaps.app_evidence: NotifyPages.tsx:239 `{profile && profile.devices.length > 0 && (...)}`. The seeded owner has devices:[], so the section is absent (app-notify-phone.png; s2.txt shows no «الجهاز»). In the reach rows (lines 101-105), choosing «call» sets device_id only when a device exists; otherwise it silently saves channel=call with no device.
gaps.owner_sees: No device row at all. Choosing «مكالمة» appears to work but cannot ring anything, and nothing explains why.
gaps.fix_plan: Always render the «الجهاز» group. List the registered devices; when none exist, show one row «هذا الجهاز» with the sub «سجّل مفتاح مرور ليصلك الاتصال», linking to the passkey registration in «الخصوصية والأمان» (no dead end). If the server's reach-me policy keeps only device_id, map «جميع الأجهزة» to device_id=null, or record it as server follow-up. When «مكالمة» is picked without a device, show the same hint row instead of saving silently.
gaps.verifier_note: Do not invent «الحاسوب»/«جميع الأجهزة» rows without a server field. Minimal safe fix: always render the group; with no devices show one non-selectable hint row «سجّل مفتاح مرور ليصلك الاتصال» linking to the passkey registration in privacy and security. Show the same hint when «مكالمة» is picked with no device (or disable that save). The incoming-call policy only rings when channel=call with a device, so do not change server semantics. Add i18n msgids (ar and en po) and a Playwright check.

gaps.title: Per-agent «التواصل الاستباقي» defaults allow calls and set no daily limit (the reference has calls off and a limit of 5)
gaps.reference_evidence: Desktop-37 3705: `a.communication||{messages:true,push:true,calls:false,...,limit:5}`, and the limit field is `required` with min 1, max 100. DESIGN_TREE_37 118: «رسائل وإشعارات، دون مكالمات، الحد 5 | الحد بين 1 و100».
gaps.app_evidence: packages/contracts/src/lonora_contracts/agent_delivery.py:16-18 `in_app: bool = True; calls: bool = True; daily_limit = None`. Live: «مكالمات الوكيل» is on and the limit field shows the placeholder «دون حد» (shots/settings1/app-communication-phone.png vs ref-communication-phone.png).
gaps.owner_sees: Every agent may call them by default, and a chatty agent has no daily cap.
gaps.fix_plan: Change the AgentDeliveryRules defaults to calls=False and daily_limit=5 (contract plus db default in agent_delivery.py delivery_rules for rows that do not exist yet). Update the TS contract and the tests. Keep the empty input meaning «دون حد» only if the owner clears it on purpose, or make the field required like the reference.
gaps.verifier_note: Changing the contract default alone is not enough. Also change db/agent_delivery.py:40 (calls=False, daily_limit=5) and rules_data/delivery_rules fallbacks for missing rows, and the TS contract. Do NOT alter schema.py server_default without a migration, since existing rows must keep their saved values (a new alembic migration changing the default is optional; setting explicit values on insert at line 40 suffices). Check the enforcement paths near db line 77 and 92, which treat daily_limit=None as unlimited, and tests that assume calls=True or no limit (pytest agent delivery and call tests). Calls default to off is the safer direction. Keep the empty input meaning «دون حد» only if the owner clears it on purpose.

steps.name: theme-switch
steps.lead_notes: One feature: the night-mode switch reveals the new theme with the growing circle from the switch (720 ms, the easing in the design tree) where View Transitions exist, and with the 280 ms thumb slide and a plain swap where they do not. Reduced motion: an instant swap. Verify in Chrome by sampling during the transition, and check the fallback path by disabling `document.startViewTransition` in a test.

gaps.title: Night-mode switch: the circle reveal never plays; the theme swaps at once
gaps.reference_evidence: Lonora-Desktop-37.html 4428-4443 toggleTheme(): `vt=document.startViewTransition(apply)` where apply re-renders synchronously, then `vt.ready.then(()=>root.animate({clipPath:[circle(0px…),circle(R…)]},{duration:720,easing:"cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)",pseudoElement:"::view-transition-new(root)"}))`. Without the API: the thumb slides, then the theme applies after 280ms. DESIGN_TREE_37.md 94 and 296 (0.72s).
gaps.app_evidence: apps/web/src/shell/settings/SettingsRoot.tsx:83-115: `start(() => setTheme(next))`. hooks/useTheme.ts:23-26 writes data-theme/.dark in a useEffect after the render, so the DOM has not changed when the transition captures the new snapshot. root.animate is called right away (line 104), not in `transition.ready`, and lasts 640ms instead of 720. With no View Transitions it calls setTheme immediately, with no 280ms thumb slide.
